events.title: Singapore Stock Market Expected To Remain Rangebound
events.description: The Singapore stock market has alternated between positive and negative finishes through the last four trading days since the end of the two-day losing streak in which it had dipped more than 10 points or 0.2 percent. The STI now sits just above the 5,415-point plateau although it may tick higher again on Tuesday.

events.title: South Korea GDP Grows 1.0% In Q3
events.description: South Korea's gross domestic product expanded a seasonally adjusted 1.0 percent on quarter in the third quarter of 2026, the Bank of Korea said in Tuesday's preliminary report.

events.title: Malaysia Stock Market May See Renewed Support
events.description: The Malaysia stock market on Monday ended the four-day winning streak in which it had risen almost 15 points or 0.9 percent. The Kuala Lumpur Composite Index now sits just above the 1,600-point plateau although it's tipped to rebound again on Tuesday.

events.title: Japan Stock Market May Halt Losing Streak
events.description: The Japan stock market has moved lower in three straight sessions, sinking almost 1,450 points or 2.2 percent along the way. The Nikkei now sits just beneath the 62,190-point plateau although it may stop the bleeding on Tuesday.

events.title: Rebound Anticipated For South Korea Shares
events.description: The South Korea stock market has alternated between positive and negative finishes through the last five trading days since the end of the two-day winning streak in which it had rallied more than 210 points or 3.6 percent. The KOSPI now sits just beneath the 5,470-point plateau although it's likely to bounce higher again on Tuesday.

events.title: South Korea GDP Data Due On Tuesday
events.description: South Korea will on Tuesday release preliminary Q3 figures for gross domestic product, highlighting a light day for Asia-Pacific economic activity.

events.title: U.S. Dollar Ticks Higher Amid Concerns Of Potential U.S. Attacks On Iran
events.description: The U.S. Dollar value inched higher on Monday with Middle East tensions rising after CNN reported that U.S. forces are preparing for a major operation against Iran. Traders also analyzed Iran's announcement of a Qatari delegation visiting Iran that kept up expectations for a diplomatic resolution to the crisis.

events.title: Swiss Market Ends On Firm Note
events.description: Save for a very brief while at the start, the Switzerland market's benchmark index SMI stayed positive throughout the session on Monday thanks to easing inflation concerns and optimism about corporate earnings.

events.title: Easing Inflation Concerns Lift European Market Sentiment
events.description: European markets closed higher Monday as oil prices fell on diplomatic efforts to reduce West Asia tensions. Central bank meetings this week include decisions from the Federal Reserve, European Central Bank, and Bank of Japan.

events.title: Materials, Bank Stocks Lift Canadian Market
events.description: The Canadian market, which moved higher after opening slightly up, remains in positive territory a little past noon on Monday amid slightly easing concerns about inflation thanks to a drop in oil prices.

events.title: Verizon Lifts FY26 Outlook After Higher Q3; Signs $2 Bln AI Deal With AWS; Stock Drops
events.description: Telecom major Verizon Communications Inc. on Monday reported higher third-quarter results and raised fiscal 2026 forecast. Further, the company announced that it has signed an agreement valued at more than $2.0 billion with Amazon Web Services or AWS to expand its AI Infrastructure. In the early morning trading on the NYSE, VZ shares were losing around 2.34 percent.

events.title: Canadian Market Likely To Open On Positive Note
events.description:
Higher precious metals prices and easing concerns about inflation thanks to a drop in oil prices suggest a positive start for stocks on Bay Street Monday morning. 

With a slew of corporate earnings updates from Canada and U.S. due this week, the mood in the market is likely to remain a bit cautious.

events.title: Dollar Index Edged Down Last Week
events.description: The U.S. Dollar retreated and the Dollar Index edged down during the week ended October 23 that witnessed renewed AI jitters and geopolitical tensions. Expectations of a monetary policy pause by the Federal Reserve kept the Dollar Index subdued. The debt-market-turmoil in Fance also weighed on currency market sentiment.
